function ssrRender(_ctx, _push, _parent, _attrs) {
  _push(_ssrRenderComponent(_resolveComponent("Comp"), _attrs, _createSlots({
    "a.b.c": _withCtx((_, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
      if (_push) {
        _push(`abc`)
      } else {
        return [_createTextVNode("abc")]
      }
    }),
    _: 2 /* DYNAMIC */
  }, [
    (_ctx.ok) ? {
      name: "item.alpha",
      fn: _withCtx((_, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
        if (_push) {
          _push(`ifslot`)
        } else {
          return [_createTextVNode("ifslot")]
        }
      }),
      key: "0"
    } : undefined,
    _renderList(_ctx.names, (n) => {
      return {
        name: n,
        fn: _withCtx((_, _push, _parent, _scopeId) => {
          if (_push) {
            _push(`${_ssrInterpolate(n)}`)
          } else {
            return [_createTextVNode(_toDisplayString(n))]
          }
        })
      }
    })
  ]), _parent))
}
